title: 3-Day Rule Gate: First 150 labelled rows in labels.csv + 90% Week 1 G6 task progress
gate: PR to diagnosis/submissions/<pack_id>/<github-handle>/labels.csv with >=150 valid rows; pr-guard green; 90% proof on assigned Week 1 G6 module.

title: Week 1 Data Diagnosis Gate: All 500 rows in labels.csv + medicine.md with harm tests
gate: All 500 rows labelled in labels.csv + medicine.md (top 3 diseases, regex/script fixes, before/after examples, harm test <=1% gold drop).

title: Zero-Overhead CUDA Event Step Profiler (teams/06-performance/perfkit/timer.py)
gate: Deferred-sync CUDA Event timer recording ke_encode, attention, moe, reversible_fwd, loss, backward, optimizer, comms; zero-overhead no-op toggle verified by unit test.

title: Repeatability Benchmark Harness & Sparse MoE MFU Engine (teams/06-performance/perfkit/bench.py)
gate: Warmup + timed steps, p50/p90/mean/std breakdown, tokens/s, Sparse MoE active-FLOP MFU, peak VRAM, and automated check that two baseline runs agree within <=5% for every part.

title: Correctness & 1.01x Mutation Test Framework (teams/06-performance/correctness/framework.py)
gate: Forward parity, backward input/weight grad parity, bit-deterministic rerun check, and 1.01x fast-output mutation negative test.

title: KE2 Encode/Decode Correctness Suite (teams/06-performance/correctness/test_ke.py)
gate: pytest passes on KE2 encode/decode reference vs fast implementation (integrating G4 reference on 28 Oct) and fails when fast output is multiplied by 1.01.

title: Hybrid SWA + Full GQA Correctness Suite (teams/06-performance/correctness/test_attention.py)
gate: pytest passes on GQA (48Q/4KV, head_dim=64, QK-norm, 3:1 SWA window=512 + Full Attention) forward/backward parity and fails on 1.01x perturbation.

title: Fine-Grained 384+1 MoE Token Permute & SwiGLU Correctness Suite (teams/06-performance/correctness/test_moe.py)
gate: pytest passes on SwiGLU MoE (384 routed + 1 shared expert, top-6 routing, token permutation, uniform + skewed/empty expert loads) forward/backward grad parity and fails on 1.01x perturbation.

title: Reversible Residual Block Bit-Deterministic Reconstruction & Custom Autograd Suite (teams/06-performance/correctness/test_reversible.py)
gate: pytest passes on exact reversible state reconstruction (X1, X2), custom autograd backward gradient parity vs standard autograd, bit-determinism, and fails on 1.01x perturbation.

title: First Baseline Timing Report (teams/06-performance/results/baseline_v0.md)
gate: Committed baseline_v0.md with GPU name, git commit SHA, per-part ms breakdown on G5 small config, and 2 runs agreeing within <=5% for every part.

title: Top 5 Bottlenecks, Profiler Traces & Week 2 Kernel Designs (teams/06-performance/results/slowest5_v0.md)
gate: Committed slowest5_v0.md listing the 5 slowest parts of the training step, each with a torch.profiler trace summary and 1 concrete Week 2 Triton/CUDA optimization proposal.

title: System Metrics & MFU Handoff to G8 + Gate 1 Verification
gate: All 3 Gate 1 checks pass: (1) pytest teams/06-performance/correctness -q == 0 failures, (2) 1.01x broken function fails, (3) 2 baseline runs agree <=5%. Metrics handed off to G8.

title: Cross-Team Dependency: Receive Harness & Small Configs from Team G5 (Training)
gate: G5 delivers training harness and small configs for G6 baseline timing.

title: Cross-Team Dependency: Receive KE2 Decode Reference from Team G4 (Architecture)
gate: G4 delivers KE2 decode reference implementation for test_ke.py.

title: Week 2 (Gate 2): Shared H100 Node Baseline, G5 Arm Timings, 2 Fused Triton Speedups & speed_v1.md
owner: Member01–Member06 (1 Kernel/Profile Track Each) + W2 Rotation
gate: Node baseline on shared H100; time G5 arms; land >=2 kernel speedups (MoE, Attention, Reversible, or KE2) with parity tests; publish speed_v1.md.

title: Week 3 (Gate 3): Dry Run 1 Full-Width Profile, MoE Dispatch/All-to-All & Fused Kernels
gate: Full-width profile of Dry Run 1 (torch.profiler, Nsight); profile MoE dispatch, all-to-all, checkpoint save; test fused kernels against reference.

title: Kernel Freeze (23 Nov) & Dry Run 2 Speed Comparison
gate: All production kernels frozen by 23 Nov; Dry Run 2 speed & MFU verified on 24–26 Nov.

title: Week 4 (Gate 4): Launch Commit Correctness Check & speed_backlog.md
gate: Full correctness suite passes on launch commit; speed check signed off; speed_backlog.md published before main training run starts on 28 Nov.

title: Shared Foundation: Data Diagnosis Taxonomy (DISEASES.md) & V5 Training Loop Basics
gate: Study: diagnosis/DISEASES.md (codes A1–G2), Session 4 notes (FineWeb/Dolma filters, <=1% gold drop harm test), Session 10 notes (BF16/FP8 & MFU), and Triton Tutorials 01–02. Practice: Inspect 10 rows with view_pack.py --hex and write a 1.01x assert_close failure test.

title: Member01 Study & Practice: Numerical Tolerances, Autograd Grad Check & Determinism (framework.py)
gate: Study: Session 10 (BF16/FP8 precision), Session 15 (§4–6 silent bugs & spikes), PyTorch assert_close & determinism docs. Practice: Build assert_kernel_correctness() checking fwd/bwd grads, bit-determinism, and 1.01x mutation failure.

title: Member02 Study & Practice: Sparse MoE Routing, Token Permutation & Grouped GEMMs (test_moe.py)
gate: Study: Session 14 (384+1 experts, top-6 routing, aux-free bias), DeepSeekMoE (arXiv:2401.06066), DeepSeek-V3 (arXiv:2412.19437 §3), MegaBlocks (arXiv:2211.15841), ScatterMoE (arXiv:2403.08245), PMPP Ch. 9 & 11 (Histogram & Prefix Scan). Practice: Token permute/unpermute without .item() syncs; test skewed/empty experts.

title: Member03 Study & Practice: Factorized/Kernelized Embedding (KE2) & Cut Cross-Entropy (test_ke.py)
gate: Study: Session 16 System Walkthrough (Embedding/LM Head parameterization), Cut Cross-Entropy (arXiv:2411.09009), Liger Kernel (arXiv:2410.10989), Triton Tutorials 01–03. Practice: Pluggable KE2 encode/decode autograd wrapper & parity suite.

title: Member04 Study & Practice: FlashAttention 1–3, Hybrid 3:1 SWA + Full GQA & QK-Norm (test_attention.py)
gate: Study: Session 16 First Principles §2 (3:1 SWA W=512 + Full Attention, GQA 48Q/4KV, QK-norm), FlashAttention 1–3 (arXiv:2205.14135, 2307.08691, 2407.08608), Liger Kernel (arXiv:2410.10989), Triton Tutorials 05–06. Practice: Explicit SWA/Causal GQA ref vs SDPA/FlexAttention.

title: Member05 Study & Practice: Reversible Residual Networks, Custom Autograd & Bit-Determinism (test_reversible.py)
gate: Study: Session 16 First Principles §1 & Walkthrough §1 (Reversible reconstruction X2=Y2-G(Y1), X1=Y1-F(X2)), RevNet (arXiv:1707.04585), Reformer (arXiv:2001.04451), PMPP Ch. 10 (Deterministic Reductions). Practice: Custom ReversibleBlockFunction without saving intermediate activations.

title: Member06 Study & Practice: Deferred CUDA Events, Roofline Profiling & Sparse MoE MFU (timer.py & bench.py)
gate: Study: Session 16 Scaling Laws & FLOP Accounting (6*N_active + Attention FLOPs), Session 10 (MFU), OLMo 2 (arXiv:2501.00656 §3), PMPP Ch. 4–6 & Nsight Roofline guide. Practice: Deferred CUDA event StepTimer with zero-overhead disabled mode & 2-run <=5% spread verifier.
